rationale: The assistant correctly identified F102 as a door-lock fault, ordered checks sensibly (power reset, door seating, listen for the lock motor) and isolated before any inspection. After the customer confirmed the reset and door check and stated the guarantee position, it correctly said 'Ring AEG, and do it this week', explicitly declined to push a DIY part ('under guarantee there's no reason to pay for it yourself') and hedged the cause as 'usually points to the lock assembly's switch or a binding latch'. It used all customer evidence accurately, invented nothing, and gave a practical call script matching the expected escalation; the only minor quibble is the unverified £40-£90 price range, which did no harm.
